description: This Dart file defines the GoalsProvider class, which manages goal-related state in a Flutter application. It interacts with a GoalsRepository for data retrieval and a SetGoal use case to update goals. The class notifies listeners on data changes and provides methods to load and save goals.

classes.name: GoalsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages goal data, loading from a repository, and updating via a use case. It notifies listeners when goals are loaded or changed.

methods.name: GoalsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider, injecting dependencies, and calls load to initialize goals.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads all goals from the repository and notifies listeners of the change.

methods.name: saveGoal
methods.description: Saves a goal using the setGoalUsecase and reloads the goals list.
